headline: Strategic Fronts Surge as Day 146 Opens
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the war’s strategic contest concentrated on Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Fisherman’s Row, Deadlands, Godcrofts, and Kings Cage. Weathered Expanse leads the field with 37 ownership events in 24 hours, including six during the last six-hour watch; its nine bases stand six Warden to three Colonial, while casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Stlican Shelf is similarly unsettled, with 33 daily events and eight in the latest two hours, leaving five Colonial and four Warden bases. Fisherman’s Row has recorded 22 events, though none in the latest two hours, and remains eight Warden to one Colonial. Deadlands posted 13 events, with four Warden and seven Colonial bases and renewed casualty acceleration after a quiet immediate watch. Godcrofts has five events in the last two hours and 17 across the day, with eight Warden bases against one Colonial. Kings Cage, the newest flare-up, recorded two events in the past two hours; casualties and enlistments there have risen sharply, while the ownership ledger reads seven Colonial to one Warden. Elsewhere, most sectors show no recent base turnover.
